description: This Java source file defines the REST API resource for managing General Ledger (GL) accounts in the Fineract accounting module. It includes endpoints for CRUD operations (create, retrieve, update, delete), template retrieval, bulk import/export of GL account data, and related helper methods. It leverages JAX-RS annotations for REST mappings, Swagger annotations for API documentation, and integrates with several platform services for business logic and security.

classes.name: GLAccountsApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource for managing General Ledger accounts, providing endpoints for CRUD operations, template retrieval, bulk operations, and detailed account information.

methods.name: retrieveNewAccountDetails
methods.description: Returns template data to assist in creating a new GL account, optionally customized by type.

methods.name: retrieveAllAccounts
methods.description: Fetches a list of all GL accounts with optional filters such as type, usage, manual entries allowed, disabled status, and whether to fetch running balances.

methods.name: retreiveAccount
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific GL account by ID, with options to include running balance and template-specific data.

methods.name: createGLAccount
methods.description: Creates a new GL account based on the provided command object.

methods.name: updateGLAccount
methods.description: Updates an existing GL account identified by ID with data from the provided command object.

methods.name: deleteGLAccount
methods.description: Deletes the specified GL account by ID.

methods.name: getGlAccountsTemplate
methods.description: Provides an Excel template for bulk import of GL accounts.

methods.name: postGlAccountsTemplate
methods.description: Handles the upload of a GL accounts bulk import Excel file.

methods.name: handleTemplate
methods.description: Augments GL account data with additional options and related codes for template responses.
